description: This is a Kotlin class defining an Android activity named LoginActivity, which provides a login screen with D-pad navigation, focus handling, input validation, and a simple sign-in simulation.

classes.name: LoginActivity
classes.description: An activity providing a TV-friendly login interface with focus handling, validation, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets focusability, input options, and focus change animations, and configures button click and keyboard actions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on username and password, ensuring basic rules are met, and returns corresponding error messages.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles login submission, performs validation, displays errors or success toast, and navigates back.
